scope.quote: Artificial Intelligence, Cognitive Science and related disciplines

ai_policy.quote: Use of an LLM should be properly documented in the Methods section

rules.quote: Abbreviations should be defined at first mention
rules.requirement: Define abbreviations at first use.

rules.quote: The abstract should not contain any undefined abbreviations
rules.requirement: Define abbreviations in the abstract.

rules.quote: an abstract of 150 to 250 words.
an abstract of 150 to 250 words.
Please provide an abstract of 150 to 250 words.
rules.requirement: Provide an abstract.

rules.quote: or unspecified references.
rules.requirement: Avoid unspecified references in the abstract.

rules.quote: should be placed in a separate section on the title page.
rules.requirement: Place acknowledgments on the title page.

rules.quote: state-of-the-art research reports and critical evaluations of applications, techniques and algorithms
rules.requirement: Explain the contribution to AI or cognitive science research.

rules.quote: The affiliation(s) of the author(s), i.e. institution, (department), city, (state), country
rules.requirement: List author affiliations.

rules.quote: The name(s) of the author(s)
rules.requirement: List author names.

rules.quote: Cite references in the text by name and year in parentheses.
rules.requirement: Use author-year in-text citations.

rules.quote: its publication has been approved by all co-authors
rules.requirement: Obtain coauthor approval.

rules.quote: Authors are required to disclose financial or non-financial interests
rules.requirement: Disclose relevant financial and nonfinancial interests.

rules.quote: A clear indication and an active e-mail address of the corresponding author
rules.requirement: Identify the corresponding author and active email.

rules.quote: All original research must include a data availability statement.
rules.requirement: Include a data availability statement for original research.

rules.quote: cite any publicly available data on which the conclusions of the paper rely
rules.requirement: Cite public supporting datasets.

rules.quote: under the heading "Statements and Declarations"
rules.requirement: Include applicable statements under Statements and Declarations.

rules.quote: include DOIs as full DOI links in your reference list
rules.requirement: Use full DOI links where available.

rules.quote: provide all relevant editable source files at every submission and revision
rules.requirement: Provide complete editable source files.

rules.quote: All figures have descriptive captions
rules.requirement: Make figures accessible with descriptive captions and other requested measures.

rules.quote: Each figure should have a concise caption
rules.requirement: Provide figure captions.

rules.quote: Figures should always be cited in text in consecutive numerical order.
rules.requirement: Cite figures consecutively.

rules.quote: All figures are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number figures with Arabic numerals.

rules.quote: Always use footnotes instead of endnotes.
rules.requirement: Use footnotes rather than endnotes.

rules.quote: include information regarding sources of funding
rules.requirement: Disclose applicable funding.

rules.quote: decimal system of headings with no more than three levels
rules.requirement: Use up to three numbered heading levels.

rules.quote: informed consent if the research involved human participants
rules.requirement: Include applicable human-participant consent statements.

rules.quote: 4 to 6 keywords
4 to 6 keywords
Please do not use subfolders for your LaTeX submission
rules.requirement: Keep LaTeX upload files outside subfolders.

rules.quote: original source (including all style files and figures) and a PDF version
rules.requirement: Include original source and compiled PDF for LaTeX submissions.

rules.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, do not currently satisfy our authorship criteria.
rules.requirement: Do not list LLMs as authors.

rules.quote: Use of an LLM should be properly documented in the Methods section
rules.requirement: Document substantive LLM use in Methods or another suitable section.

rules.quote: If available, the 16-digit ORCID of the author(s)
rules.requirement: Include available author ORCID identifiers.

rules.quote: the work described has not been published before
rules.requirement: Submit original work or transparently disclose an eligible expansion.

rules.quote: obtain permission from the copyright owner(s) for both the print and online format
rules.requirement: Obtain permission for reused published material.

rules.quote: alphabetized by the last names of the first author
rules.requirement: Alphabetize references by first-author surname.

rules.quote: only include works that are cited in the text
rules.requirement: List only cited published or accepted references.

rules.quote: without fabrication, falsification or inappropriate data manipulation
rules.requirement: Present results without fabrication or falsification.

rules.quote: describe how data can be accessed and any conditions for reuse
rules.requirement: Explain conditions for access if data cannot be public.

rules.quote: For each supplementary material, please supply a concise caption
rules.requirement: Provide a caption for each supplementary item.

rules.quote: text must make specific mention of the material as a citation
rules.requirement: Cite supplementary material in the text.

rules.quote: For each table, please supply a table caption
rules.requirement: Provide table captions.

rules.quote: Tables should always be cited in text in consecutive numerical order.
rules.requirement: Cite tables consecutively.

rules.quote: All tables are to be numbered using Arabic numerals.
rules.requirement: Number tables with Arabic numerals.

rules.quote: The title should be concise and informative.
rules.requirement: Use a concise informative title.

rules.quote: Please make sure your title page contains the following information.
rules.requirement: Provide a title page with requested metadata.
